# Incident Report: Poor Accessibility on S-TUN-017

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-TUN-017`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of a config change at 03:41 matching the KPI degradation onset at 03:30-03:40; sibling sites receiving the exact same template at the same time showed identical failures; maintenance, transport, power, and external events were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-18 03:30 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-18 03:41
- **Affected:** S-TUN-017, S-TUN-008, S-TUN-009

## Summary

Push of RAN parameter template RT-2.4 (admission control, RRC timers) via config push CHG-2026-0047 at 2026-09-18 03:41 caused RRC success rate degradation and accessibility issues on S-TUN-017.

S-TUN-017 experienced poor accessibility with rrc_success_pct dropping and drop_rate_pct spiking starting around 03:30-03:40 on 2026-09-18. The impact is ongoing as of 08:13.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-18 03:30: Earliest onset of KPI deviation observed: S-TUN-017 rrc_success_pct fell below baseline. [T3, ANM-000227]
- 2026-09-18 03:41: Config push CHG-2026-0047 applied: Push RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to S-TUN-017. [CHG-2026-0047]
- 2026-09-18 03:45: ANM-000229 drop_rate_pct spike ongoing on S-TUN-017. [ANM-000229]
- 2026-09-18 03:58: Minor alarm ALM-000366 RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH raised on S-TUN-008. [ALM-000366, T13]

## Evidence

- S-TUN-017 experienced a drop in rrc_success_pct below baseline starting at 03:30. [T3, ANM-000227]
- Config push CHG-2026-0047 applied RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to S-TUN-017 at 2026-09-18 03:41. [CHG-2026-0047, T10]
- Neighboring sites S-TUN-008 and S-TUN-009 received identical RT-2.4 parameter template pushes (CHG-2026-0045, CHG-2026-0046) at 03:41 and experienced identical RRC success rate degradations starting at 03:30. [T6, T7, CHG-2026-0045, CHG-2026-0046]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-017, LNK-TUN-02-B, AGG-TUN-02 or their parents. [T8]
- No external events were recorded for region TUN between 02:00 and 08:13. [T14]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-TUN-017: confirmed. Config push CHG-2026-0047 pushed template RT-2.4 right at the time of accessibility degradation, with sibling sites experiencing the exact same failure upon receiving the same change. [CHG-2026-0047, T3, T7]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-02-B: rejected. No critical or major alarms on transport links or aggregation router AGG-TUN-02, and other sibling sites under the same aggregator did not show uniform transport failure. [T4, T13]
3. **planned_maintenance** at S-TUN-017: rejected. Maintenance query returned no scheduled windows on S-TUN-017 or its parent chain. [T8]

## Ruled out

- T8: No maintenance windows were active or scheduled during the incident window.
- T14: No external events occurred in region TUN during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Roll back config push CHG-2026-0047 on S-TUN-017, as well as CHG-2026-0045 and CHG-2026-0046 on S-TUN-008 and S-TUN-009.
- Review RAN parameter template RT-2.4 settings regarding admission control and RRC timers.

## Sources

- `T3`: query_kpis(entity_type=site, entity_ids=['S-TUN-017'], metrics=['rrc_success_pct', 'drop_rate_pct', 'availability_pct'], start=2026-09-18 02:00:00, en -> Deviation in 2 of 3 series. Earliest onset 2026-09-18 03:30: S-TUN-017 rrc_success_pct below baseline.

result.question: S-TUN-017 shows poor accessibility since 03:40. Why?

report.confidence_reason: Direct evidence of a config change at 03:41 matching the KPI degradation onset at 03:30-03:40; sibling sites receiving the exact same template at the same time showed identical failures; maintenance, transport, power, and external events were checked and ruled out.

dismissed_signals.reason: No maintenance windows were active or scheduled during the incident window.
No external events occurred in region TUN during the incident window.

findings.claim: S-TUN-017 experienced a drop in rrc_success_pct below baseline starting at 03:30.
Config push CHG-2026-0047 applied RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to S-TUN-017 at 2026-09-18 03:41.

Neighboring sites S-TUN-008 and S-TUN-009 received identical RT-2.4 parameter template pushes (CHG-2026-0045, CHG-2026-0046) at 03:41 and experienced identical RRC success rate degradations starting at 03:30.
No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-017, LNK-TUN-02-B, AGG-TUN-02 or their parents.
No external events were recorded for region TUN between 02:00 and 08:13.

hypotheses.reason: Config push CHG-2026-0047 pushed template RT-2.4 right at the time of accessibility degradation, with sibling sites experiencing the exact same failure upon receiving the same change.
No critical or major alarms on transport links or aggregation router AGG-TUN-02, and other sibling sites under the same aggregator did not show uniform transport failure.
Maintenance query returned no scheduled windows on S-TUN-017 or its parent chain.

report.impact_summary: S-TUN-017 experienced poor accessibility with rrc_success_pct dropping and drop_rate_pct spiking starting around 03:30-03:40 on 2026-09-18. The impact is ongoing as of 08:13.
recommended_actions: Roll back config push CHG-2026-0047 on S-TUN-017, as well as CHG-2026-0045 and CHG-2026-0046 on S-TUN-008 and S-TUN-009.
Review RAN parameter template RT-2.4 settings regarding admission control and RRC timers.
report.root_cause_summary: Push of RAN parameter template RT-2.4 (admission control, RRC timers) via config push CHG-2026-0047 at 2026-09-18 03:41 caused RRC success rate degradation and accessibility issues on S-TUN-017.
